evidence.notes: [HISTORICAL — superseded by the #321 re-grade below: this record is a hydrate of CHEBI:30808, not an exact match to it] Imported from CultureMech pipeline, quality=DIRECT_MATCH

identifier CHEBI:30808 -> kgmicrobe.compound:fecl3_x_4_h2o; mapping_quality EXACT_MATCH -> NARROW_MATCH. The record is a hydrate of CHEBI:30808 ('iron trichloride') and was sharing that term's identifier — the identity collapse MAPPING_SEMANTICS §3 forbids, which made a distinct substance indistinguishable from its anhydrous parent downstream. ChEBI has no term for this hydrate and the record carries no verified CAS, so steps 1 and 2 are unavailable and step 3 applies.

molecular_formula 'Cl3Fe' -> 'Cl3Fe.4H2O'. The recorded value described the anhydrous salt while the label names a hydrate, understating the mass by 18 g/mol per water. Corrected because the label states 4 water(s) of hydration, and the recorded formula was byte-identical to the anhydrous parent CHEBI:30808's ChEBI formula ('Cl3Fe') — the mark of a value inherited from the parent rather than measured for this record. Water appended in ChEBI's own dot-separated notation.

mapping_quality NARROW_MATCH -> CLOSE_MATCH, predicate skos:narrowMatch -> skos:closeMatch. narrowMatch asserts this record is *narrower in meaning* than CHEBI:30808 ('iron trichloride') — a subsumption ChEBI itself denies: it files hydrates under CHEBI:35505 'hydrate', never under the anhydrous compound, which is not an ancestor even transitively. A hydrate is a distinct substance containing the anhydrous form, not a specialization of it. closeMatch claims similarity without subsumption. The ontology_id and the record's own identifier are unchanged.

mediadive.compound:922 still carries the source label 'FeCl3 x 4 H2O', but no exact ontology term or CAS has been verified for that stated hydration count. CHEBI:30808 (iron trichloride) is retained only as the closest anhydrous parent while the source label keeps its local kgmicrobe.compound identity.

evidence.notes: [HISTORICAL — superseded by the #321 re-grade below: this record is a hydrate of CHEBI:35458, not an exact match to it] Imported from CultureMech pipeline, quality=DIRECT_MATCH

identifier CHEBI:35458 -> kgmicrobe.compound:cecl3_x_7_h2o; mapping_quality EXACT_MATCH -> NARROW_MATCH. The record is a hydrate of CHEBI:35458 ('cerium trichloride') and was sharing that term's identifier — the identity collapse MAPPING_SEMANTICS §3 forbids, which made a distinct substance indistinguishable from its anhydrous parent downstream. ChEBI has no term for this hydrate and the record carries no verified CAS, so steps 1 and 2 are unavailable and step 3 applies.

molecular_formula 'CeCl3' -> 'CeCl3.7H2O'. The recorded value described the anhydrous salt while the label names a hydrate, understating the mass by 18 g/mol per water. Corrected because the label states 7 water(s) of hydration, and the recorded formula was byte-identical to the anhydrous parent CHEBI:35458's ChEBI formula ('CeCl3') — the mark of a value inherited from the parent rather than measured for this record. Water appended in ChEBI's own dot-separated notation.

mapping_quality NARROW_MATCH -> CLOSE_MATCH, predicate skos:narrowMatch -> skos:closeMatch. narrowMatch asserts this record is *narrower in meaning* than CHEBI:35458 ('cerium trichloride') — a subsumption ChEBI itself denies: it files hydrates under CHEBI:35505 'hydrate', never under the anhydrous compound, which is not an ancestor even transitively. A hydrate is a distinct substance containing the anhydrous form, not a specialization of it. closeMatch claims similarity without subsumption. The ontology_id and the record's own identifier are unchanged.

Four current source recipes and MediaDive1444 name CeCl3·7H2O. Independent supplier/PubChem agree on specific CAS18618-55-8 and formula. The complete ignored-inclusive neighbor scan found no other current owner of this CAS. No eligible exact CHEBI/NCIT term was established by the bounded current CAS/name queries. Promote local primary to cas:18618-55-8, preserve the old local registry identity, and broadMatch CHEBI35458. Existing CeCl3.7H2O matches. Add evidenced CAS only; do not automatically copy a PubChem structure/CID. Primary source references: https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/US/en/product/aldrich/228931; https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/substance/sourceid/Sigma-Aldrich/228931_ALDRICH/JSON; https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/18618-55-8/property/Title,MolecularFormula,MolecularWeight,InChI,InChIKey,CanonicalSMILES/JSON; https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/35458/. Captures, exact input hashes and scope limits: reports/step7d_mapping_901_20261103/evidence-manifest.json. This curation adds no scientific, mapping-release or role approval; changed owner bytes withdraw inherited support.
